title: Well Well Well
description: Small datapack that adds smart Wishing Wells to minecraft.
body:
This small datapack adds a variety of new structures as well as an update to a classic! Wishing Wells now generate in various biomes, primarily Plains, Cherry Groves and Mangrove Swamps.

Wishing Wells take Gold Ingots as currency, and they aren't dumb. Wishing Wells provide for the players needs at the time. If you're hungry, they'll provide food. If you're weak, they'll provide potions. The Wishing Well will ALWAYS give you something you don't have, or something you need. If you already have everything, they'll give you a better version of something you do have.

This pack was made in under 2 hours, primarily as a challenge to myself so there may be bugs. Feel free to join the Discord to bring bugs and issues to my attention.
